$comment: Whole-product review eval. seeded must raise every rule in must; clean must raise none of the rules in watch. Rules come from checks/structure.json and checks/consistency.json. The clean version must also have no P0-P2 finding from any check (checks/all.json), so a gate run on it passes the finding rule. Folders are named v1 (seeded), v2 (clean) and v3 (framework: v2 built with a shadow-root tab bar, a modal sheet and animated page changes) so their paths tell a reviewer nothing. states: screens the crawl must reach, by title; no_failed_taps: no tap or replay may fail.

lenses.$comment: Scored by npm run eval:lenses after /designcritique:review on v1.yaml (seeded) or v2.yaml (clean). The checks already find every seeded flaw, so the lenses are scored on what only judgement adds: proposals, verdicts and cited principles. clean: no P0/P1 from any reviewer, no move a reviewer rates high impact, and no cut or deferral of a feature the frame puts in the MVP. Lower-impact proposals are allowed: a sparring partner suggests alternatives on a good design too. Until 2026-11-22 the clean bar was 'no cut or move proposal at all'; the designer replaced it, after the prototype had been corrected three times on what the reviewers found (see evals/README.md).
